This week's papers, by specialty

Pick a department on the left and Rounds fetches the newest indexed articles for it. Tap the star to save any paper to your reading list.

NOTICE

Not a substitute for clinical judgment. This shows raw, unreviewed PubMed abstracts sorted by publish date — not vetted point-of-care recommendations. Confirm dosing, guidelines, and applicability against primary sources or your institution's protocols before acting on anything here.

      SECTION 02 · BY BODY SYSTEM

      Guidelines & algorithms

      Search a condition to load its management outline tailored to South Asian practice. This view auto-checks PubMed for newly indexed guideline-type publications each time you open it and flags what's new by body system — plus links straight to the issuing society's guideline & algorithm hub.

      SECTION 03 · LABELS · CALCULATOR · APPROVALS

      Drugs

      Full prescribing information, sourced live from openFDA structured product labels.

      Drug-based dosing. Pick an agent and regimen, enter patient weight, and the calculator applies that drug's per-kg dose to give you a recommended dose, per-dose split, daily cap, and renal note. These are aids, not prescriptions — verify every result against the label and your institution's protocols.

      General bedside tools

      SOFA score

      Sequential Organ Failure Assessment

      Creatinine clearance

      Cockcroft–Gault

      Sex

      IV drip rate

      Weight-based infusion

      BSA & BMI

      Mosteller BSA + BMI

      Add two or more drugs to screen for interactions. This checks a curated set of clinically important pairs and drug-class rules — it is not exhaustive. Absence of a warning here does not mean a combination is safe; always confirm against a full interaction resource and the label.

          SECTION 04 · SYNDROMES · GENETIC · CONGENITAL

          Medical conditions

          SECTION 05 · LIVE FROM PUBMED · BY FIELD

          Recent advances

          A live feed of the newest high-evidence publications reshaping bedside practice — randomized trials, society guidelines, and evidence syntheses from the last 24 months, pulled from PubMed and grouped by field. Each entry shows its publication date and links to the record on PubMed. Filter by field or search to jump to what matters on your service.

          SECTION 06 · LIVE FROM CLINICALTRIALS.GOV

          Clinical trials

          Search a condition, drug, or intervention to pull matching studies live from the U.S. National Library of Medicine’s ClinicalTrials.gov registry. Filter by recruitment status to find studies that are still enrolling, and open any record for full eligibility criteria, locations, and sponsor detail.
